road-great-dolomites-road.summary: A alpine grand route from Bolzano, Italy to Cortina d'Ampezzo, Italy, via Lake Carezza. Key character: Dolomite towers; passes; villages. Surface: paved.
road-great-dolomites-road.source: built from the road itself, as recorded in the scenic atlas
road-great-dolomites-road.slogan: A 163 km loop out of Bolzano

scenicChapters.title: Great Dolomites Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 21 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Great Dolomites Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 4 km this is Great Dolomites Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

road-great-dolomites-road.story: A 163 km round trip from Bolzano - roughly 2 h 43 in the saddle. On the way it passes Lake Carezza, Canazei, Passo Pordoi and Arabba. The highest point is about 2,250 m.
